panels.title: Battery level (%) over time
queries:
SELECT timestamp AS time, battery_level AS "Battery %"
FROM battery_samples
ORDER BY timestamp

panels.title: Rated range (km) over time
queries:
SELECT timestamp AS time, battery_range_km AS "Rated range (km)", ideal_battery_range_km AS "Ideal range (km)"
FROM battery_samples
ORDER BY timestamp

panels.title: Total charges (90d)
queries: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM charging_sessions WHERE status = 'closed' AND start_time >= datetime('now', '-90 days')

panels.title: Energy added (90d)
queries: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(charge_energy_added_kwh), 0) AS value FROM charging_sessions WHERE status = 'closed' AND start_time >= datetime('now', '-90 days')

panels.title: Total cost (90d)
queries: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cost), 0) AS value FROM charging_sessions WHERE status = 'closed' AND start_time >= datetime('now', '-90 days')

panels.title: Max charger power (90d)
queries: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(max_charger_power_kw), 0) AS value FROM charging_sessions WHERE status = 'closed' AND start_time >= datetime('now', '-90 days')

panels.title: Charges
queries:
SELECT
  start_time AS time,
  COALESCE(location, printf('%.4f, %.4f', latitude, longitude)) AS "Location",
  start_battery_level AS "% start",
  end_battery_level AS "% end",
  ROUND(charge_energy_added_kwh, 1) AS "kWh added",
  ROUND(charge_energy_used_kwh, 1) AS "kWh used (est.)",
  ROUND(max_charger_power_kw, 1) AS "max kW",
  ROUND(cost, 2) AS "cost",
  ROUND((julianday(end_time) - julianday(start_time)) * 24 * 60, 0) AS "min"
FROM charging_sessions
WHERE status = 'closed'
ORDER BY start_time DESC
LIMIT 500

panels.title: # of charges
queries: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM charging_sessions WHERE status = 'closed'

panels.title: Total energy added
queries: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(charge_energy_added_kwh), 0) AS value FROM charging_sessions WHERE status = 'closed'

panels.title: Total cost
queries: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cost), 0) AS value FROM charging_sessions WHERE status = 'closed'

panels.title: Ø cost / session
queries: SELECT COALESCE(AVG(cost), 0) AS value FROM charging_sessions WHERE status = 'closed'

panels.title: Ø cost / kWh
queries: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(cost) / SUM(charge_energy_added_kwh), 0) AS value FROM charging_sessions WHERE status = 'closed' AND charge_energy_added_kwh > 0

panels.title: AC/DC - Energy added
queries: SELECT CASE WHEN is_dc_fast_charge THEN 'DC' ELSE 'AC' END AS "Type", ROUND(SUM(charge_energy_added_kwh), 1) AS "kWh" FROM charging_sessions WHERE status = 'closed' GROUP BY "Type"

panels.title: AC/DC - Duration
queries: SELECT CASE WHEN is_dc_fast_charge THEN 'DC' ELSE 'AC' END AS "Type", ROUND(SUM((julianday(end_time) - julianday(start_time)) * 1440), 0) AS "Minutes" FROM charging_sessions WHERE status = 'closed' GROUP BY "Type"

panels.title: Distance ($length_unit)
queries: SELECT ROUND(CASE WHEN '$length_unit' = 'mi' THEN distance_km / 1.60934 ELSE distance_km END, 1) AS value FROM drives WHERE id = $drive_id

panels.title: Duration
queries: SELECT ROUND(duration_min, 0) AS value FROM drives WHERE id = $drive_id

panels.title: Battery start → end
queries: SELECT start_battery_level AS "Start", end_battery_level AS "End" FROM drives WHERE id = $drive_id

panels.title: Max speed ($length_unit/h)
queries: SELECT ROUND(CASE WHEN '$length_unit' = 'mi' THEN max_speed_kmh / 1.60934 ELSE max_speed_kmh END, 0) AS value FROM drives WHERE id = $drive_id

panels.title: Route
queries: SELECT latitude, longitude, speed_kmh, timestamp AS time FROM positions WHERE drive_id = $drive_id AND latitude IS NOT NULL ORDER BY timestamp

panels.title: Speed & power
queries: SELECT timestamp AS time, (CASE WHEN '$length_unit' = 'mi' THEN speed_kmh / 1.60934 ELSE speed_kmh END) AS "Speed ($length_unit/h)", power_kw AS "Power (kW)" FROM positions WHERE drive_id = $drive_id ORDER BY timestamp

panels.title: Elevation (m if km, ft if mi)
queries: SELECT timestamp AS time, (CASE WHEN '$length_unit' = 'mi' THEN elevation_m * 3.28084 ELSE elevation_m END) AS "Elevation" FROM positions WHERE drive_id = $drive_id AND elevation_m IS NOT NULL ORDER BY timestamp

panels.title: Temperatures (°$temp_unit)
queries: SELECT timestamp AS time, (CASE WHEN '$temp_unit' = 'F' THEN outside_temp_c * 9.0 / 5 + 32 ELSE outside_temp_c END) AS "Outside", (CASE WHEN '$temp_unit' = 'F' THEN inside_temp_c * 9.0 / 5 + 32 ELSE inside_temp_c END) AS "Inside" FROM positions WHERE drive_id = $drive_id AND (outside_temp_c IS NOT NULL OR inside_temp_c IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY timestamp

panels.title: Tire pressure
queries: SELECT timestamp AS time, tpms_pressure_fl AS "FL", tpms_pressure_fr AS "FR", tpms_pressure_rl AS "RL", tpms_pressure_rr AS "RR" FROM positions WHERE drive_id = $drive_id ORDER BY timestamp

panels.title: # of drives
queries: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM drives WHERE status = 'closed'

panels.title: Total distance
queries: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(distance_km), 0) AS value FROM drives WHERE status = 'closed'

panels.title: Median drive distance
queries:
SELECT distance_km AS value FROM drives WHERE status = 'closed' AND distance_km IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY distance_km LIMIT 1 OFFSET (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM drives WHERE status = 'closed' AND distance_km IS NOT NULL) / 2

panels.title: Max speed ever
queries: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(max_speed_kmh), 0) AS value FROM drives WHERE status = 'closed'

panels.title: Top 10 destinations
queries:
SELECT end_location AS "Destination", COUNT(*) AS "Visits"
FROM drives
WHERE status = 'closed' AND end_location IS NOT NULL AND end_location != ''
GROUP BY end_location
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 10

panels.title: Total drives (90d)
queries: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM drives WHERE status = 'closed' AND start_time >= datetime('now', '-90 days')

panels.title: Total distance (90d)
queries: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(distance_km), 0) AS value FROM drives WHERE status = 'closed' AND start_time >= datetime('now', '-90 days')

panels.title: Avg distance per drive
queries: SELECT COALESCE(AVG(distance_km), 0) AS value FROM drives WHERE status = 'closed' AND start_time >= datetime('now', '-90 days')

panels.title: Max speed (90d)
queries: SELECT COALESCE(MAX(max_speed_kmh), 0) AS value FROM drives WHERE status = 'closed' AND start_time >= datetime('now', '-90 days')

panels.title: Drives
queries:
SELECT
  id AS drive_id,
  CAST(strftime('%s', start_time) AS INTEGER) * 1000 AS start_epoch,
  CAST(strftime('%s', end_time) AS INTEGER) * 1000 AS end_epoch,
  start_time AS time,
  COALESCE(start_location, printf('%.4f, %.4f', start_lat, start_lng)) AS "From",
  COALESCE(end_location, printf('%.4f, %.4f', end_lat, end_lng)) AS "To",
  ROUND(distance_km, 1) AS "km",
  ROUND(duration_min, 0) AS "min",
  start_battery_level AS "% start",
  end_battery_level AS "% end",
  ROUND(max_speed_kmh, 0) AS "max km/h",
  ROUND(ascent_m, 0) AS "ascent m",
  ROUND(descent_m, 0) AS "descent m"
FROM drives
WHERE status = 'closed'
ORDER BY start_time DESC
LIMIT 500

panels.title: Configured Wh/km (if set)
queries: SELECT efficiency_wh_km AS value FROM vehicles ORDER BY id LIMIT 1

panels.title: Avg battery %/km used (90d)
queries:
SELECT COALESCE(AVG((start_battery_level - end_battery_level) * 1.0 / distance_km), 0) AS value
FROM drives
WHERE status = 'closed' AND distance_km > 1 AND start_time >= datetime('now', '-90 days')

panels.title: Avg rated-range km lost per km driven (90d)
queries:
SELECT COALESCE(AVG((start_range_km - end_range_km) / distance_km), 0) AS value
FROM drives
WHERE status = 'closed' AND distance_km > 1 AND start_range_km IS NOT NULL AND end_range_km IS NOT NULL
  AND start_time >= datetime('now', '-90 days')

panels.title: Per-drive efficiency (most recent 200)
queries:
SELECT
  start_time AS time,
  ROUND(distance_km, 1) AS "km",
  (start_battery_level - end_battery_level) AS "% used",
  ROUND(CASE WHEN distance_km > 0 THEN (start_battery_level - end_battery_level) * 1.0 / distance_km ELSE NULL END, 3) AS "%/km",
  ROUND(start_range_km - end_range_km, 1) AS "rated km lost"
FROM drives
WHERE status = 'closed' AND distance_km > 0
ORDER BY start_time DESC
LIMIT 200

panels.title: # of distinct places visited
queries: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT COALESCE(end_location, printf('%.4f,%.4f', end_lat, end_lng))) AS value FROM drives WHERE status = 'closed'

panels.title: Most-visited places
queries:
SELECT
  COALESCE(end_location, printf('%.4f,%.4f', end_lat, end_lng)) AS "Place",
  COUNT(*) AS "Visits"
FROM drives
WHERE status = 'closed'
GROUP BY "Place"
ORDER BY "Visits" DESC
LIMIT 15

panels.title: Last visited
queries:
SELECT
  end_time AS time,
  COALESCE(end_location, printf('%.4f,%.4f', end_lat, end_lng)) AS "Place"
FROM drives
WHERE status = 'closed'
ORDER BY end_time DESC
LIMIT 200

panels.title: Odometer
queries:
SELECT end_time AS time, end_odometer_km AS "Odometer (km)"
FROM drives
WHERE status = 'closed' AND end_odometer_km IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY end_time

panels.title: Vehicle
queries: SELECT display_name AS "Name", model AS "Model" FROM vehicles LIMIT 1

panels.title: Lifetime odometer
queries: SELECT end_odometer_km AS value FROM drives WHERE status = 'closed' ORDER BY end_time DESC LIMIT 1

queries: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM drives WHERE status = 'closed'

panels.title: Total charges

panels.title: Software updates

panels.title: Projected range at 100% vs mileage
queries: SELECT timestamp AS time, ROUND(battery_range_km * 100.0 / NULLIF(battery_level,0), 1) AS "Projected range (km)" FROM battery_samples WHERE battery_level > 0 ORDER BY timestamp
SELECT end_time AS time, end_odometer_km AS "Mileage (km)" FROM drives WHERE status = 'closed' AND end_odometer_km IS NOT NULL ORDER BY end_time

panels.title: Currently
queries: SELECT state AS value FROM states ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1

panels.title: Recent state changes
queries:
SELECT
  started_at AS time,
  state AS "State",
  ended_at AS "Ended",
  CASE WHEN ended_at IS NOT NULL
    THEN ROUND((julianday(ended_at) - julianday(started_at)) * 24 * 60, 1)
    ELSE NULL
  END AS "Duration (min)"
FROM states
ORDER BY started_at DESC
LIMIT 500

panels.title: Per month
queries:
SELECT
  strftime('%Y-%m', start_time) AS "Month",
  ROUND(SUM(duration_min), 0) AS "Minutes driven",
  ROUND(SUM(distance_km), 1) AS "Distance (km)",
  ROUND(AVG(outside_temp_avg_c), 1) AS "Ø Temp (C)",
  COUNT(*) AS "# of drives",
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(distance_km) / NULLIF(SUM(MAX(start_range_km - end_range_km, 0)), 0), 0) AS "Efficiency %"
FROM drives
WHERE status = 'closed'
GROUP BY "Month"
ORDER BY "Month" DESC

panels.title: State timeline
queries: SELECT started_at AS time, state AS "State" FROM states ORDER BY started_at

panels.title: Time in each state (7d)
queries:
SELECT
  state AS "State",
  COUNT(*) AS "Transitions",
  ROUND(SUM((julianday(COALESCE(ended_at, strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%fZ','now'))) - julianday(started_at)) * 24), 1) AS "Total hours"
FROM states
WHERE started_at >= datetime('now', '-7 days')
GROUP BY state
ORDER BY "Total hours" DESC

panels.title: Updates
queries: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM software_updates

panels.title: Ø days between updates
queries: SELECT ROUND(AVG(gap), 1) AS value FROM (SELECT julianday(start_time) - julianday(LAG(start_time) OVER (ORDER BY start_time)) AS gap FROM software_updates) WHERE gap IS NOT NULL

panels.title: Update history
queries:
SELECT
  start_time AS time,
  version AS "Version",
  status AS "Status",
  CASE WHEN end_time IS NOT NULL THEN ROUND((julianday(end_time) - julianday(start_time)) * 1440, 0) ELSE NULL END AS "Duration (min)",
  ROUND(julianday(start_time) - julianday(LAG(start_time) OVER (ORDER BY start_time)), 1) AS "Days since previous"
FROM software_updates
ORDER BY start_time DESC

panels.title: Vampire drain
queries:
WITH samples AS (
  SELECT
    timestamp,
    battery_level,
    battery_range_km,
    LAG(timestamp) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp) AS prev_ts,
    LAG(battery_level) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp) AS prev_level,
    LAG(battery_range_km) OVER (ORDER BY timestamp) AS prev_range
  FROM battery_samples
)
SELECT
  prev_ts AS time,
  timestamp AS "End",
  ROUND((julianday(timestamp) - julianday(prev_ts)) * 24, 1) AS "Period (h)",
  prev_level AS "Start %",
  battery_level AS "End %",
  (battery_level - prev_level) AS "SoC diff",
  ROUND(prev_range - battery_range_km, 2) AS "Range loss (km)",
  ROUND((prev_range - battery_range_km) / ((julianday(timestamp) - julianday(prev_ts)) * 24), 2) AS "km lost / h"
FROM samples
WHERE prev_ts IS NOT NULL
  AND (julianday(timestamp) - julianday(prev_ts)) * 24 >= $min_idle_hours
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM drives WHERE start_time > prev_ts AND start_time < timestamp)
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM charging_sessions WHERE start_time > prev_ts AND start_time < timestamp)
  AND ABS(battery_level - prev_level) <= 15
ORDER BY prev_ts DESC
LIMIT 200
